tools.name: wake_check_site
tools.description: Probe a public hostname the way an AI agent sees it (homepage, robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap, agent card) and return scores out of 100 with concrete recommendations and publish-ready llms.txt / robots files. Input is a hostname only; the probe keeps structural signals, never page bodies. No account

tools.name: wake_about
tools.description: One paragraph on Wake (agent experience observability + agent engine optimisation for a website), with links to docs, API, MCP and signup.
